implementation_notes: One .c/.h pair (or a small set) per module, opaque structs in the header with accessors defined in the .c, and `static` for anything genuinely internal. Avoid `extern` globals — they are maximal coupling by construction. Order declarations in headers so there are no cycles.
idiom_name: opaque type + accessor functions + per-module translation unit
pitfalls: Public struct definitions in headers expose the secret
Mutually including headers (a cycle) indicate a wrong cut
